blocks.text: CT scan tasveer banane ka aisa tareeqa hai jo X-rays aur computer processing se jism ke andaruni hisson ki tafseeli tasveerein banata hai. CT ka bunyadi usool yeh hai ke jism ke mukhtalif tissues X-rays ko mukhtalif had tak jazb (absorb) karte hain. In farqon se andaruni hisson ki tafseeli tasveerein banayi ja sakti hain.

Tareeqa: CT scan ke dauran mareez motor wali mez (motorized table) par hota hai jo doughnut-numa machine mein khisakti hai jise gantry kehte hain. Gantry mein ek X-ray tube hoti hai jo mareez ke gird ghoomti hai. Gantry ki doosri taraf kai detectors record karte hain ke mukhtalif tissues se guzarte hue X-rays kitni jazb huin. Phir computer is maloomat se andaruni hisson ki tafseeli, aar paar kati hui (cross-sectional) tasveer banata hai.

Istemal: CT scans naram tissues, jaise dimagh, phephron aur pait (abdomen), ki tasveer ke liye aur haddiyon ki banawat mein kharabi dhoondne ke liye mufeed hain. CT scans cancers, infections aur choton ki pehchan ke liye istemal hote hain.

blocks.alt: Mareez motorized table par leta hai jo chhalle-numa gantry ke andar se guzarti hai. Gantry ke oopar ghoomta X-ray source mareez ke paar X-rays bhejta hai aur saamne ghoomta X-ray detector unhein leta hai; mure teer ghoomna dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mareez mez par let kar gantry ke chhalle mein se guzarta hai. Oopar ghoomta X-ray source mareez ke aar paar X-rays bhejta hai aur saamne ghoomta detector unhein pakarta hai. Jo tissue zyada X-rays jazb kare woh tasveer mein alag nazar aata hai.

blocks.prompt: CT tasveer mein mukhtalif tissues mukhtalif kyun dikhte hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh X-rays ko mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain; detectors yeh naapte hain aur computer is farq ko tasveer mein badal deta hai.
